The Shrine of the Fallen Warrior is located on a small hill in the Barrens southwest of the Crossroads. To reach it, player must follow a ridge to the southeast and half-way up the hill will find the base of a mound. The short trail will lead directly to the shrine.

SLS or Shroud Loot System was designed as a method of distributing in-game items ("loot") among a group of players in MMORPGs, specifically World of Warcraft. It was created in 2005 by the guild Shroud. The grandfather of the point based loot systems is the DKP point system, created in 1999. Shroud Loot System is also a point based loot system, but one that attempts to correct what the creators perceived are flaws in the DKP system and its variants.

The Shrine of Aessina is located in southwestern Ashenvale, southwest of Maestra's Post, south of House of Edune, and west of Astranaar. After the Cataclysm, its only inhabitant is the ancient of war known as Big Baobob. The shrine became a site of battle between the Alliance and the Horde during the Fourth War. The Alliance sought to rebuild its defenses, while the Horde was determined to burn it to the ground.

Shoveltusk, also called shovelhorn, are big neutral mammals that can be found in the Howling Fjord and the Grizzly Hills in Northrend. They are easily recognizably by their large antlers and tusks. Shoveltusk have been described as being "moose-like" or as a cross between a boar and a stag. Sometimes one can see two stags in a fight, ramming into each other with their horns. It is also not uncommon to see worgs run up to and slaughter them.

The Shrine of Goldrinn is a shrine built to honor the wolf god Goldrinn, known as Lo'Gosh ("Ghost Wolf" in Taur-ahe) by the tauren. Warriors from all walks visit the shrine in hopes of tapping into the legendary battle prowess. It can be found in a valley west of the Verdant Thicket in Mount Hyjal. Takrik Ragehowl was in the process of refurbishing the shrine when he and others were attacked by worgen, that arrived with the Twilight's Hammer, seeking to corrupt the wolf god for their own purpose. Shylenai is a night elf owl vendor located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved. Shylenai survived the Burning and made her way to Stormwind Embassy.

.]] Dwarven siege engines (or siege tanks) are tanks constructed and usually manned by dwarves. Siege engines were replacements to the dwarven steam tanks of the Third War. The siege engine prototype was invented by Gelbin Mekkatorque, the current High Tinker of the gnomes. The stalwart dwarven pilots have even been known to ram enemy structures at high speeds and reduce whole fortifications to dust under the siege engines' steel treads. Some Siege Engines were upgraded with anti-air rockets to take out enemy fliers.

__NOTOC__ Sian'tsu is a jungle troll shaman trainer located just outside Miwana's Longhouse in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, she was located in Grommash Hold. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. She appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.

Sickly Gazelles are gazelles native to the Barrens. They have become poisoned by the corrupted waters of Dreadmist Peak and require the aid of a Curative Animal Salve to restore them to normal. Sickly Gazelles are skinnable.
Sickly Deer are deer found in Darkshore prior to the Cataclys. They had been poisoned in some fashion and were in need of curing.

Siege crossbows are scaled-up versions of the man-sized weapons, mounted on table-like support structures and designed to throw heavy iron bolts incredible distances. Even the smallest siege crossbow has a bowspan of nine feet, and requires multiple soldiers to cock and load.

Shy-Rotam is the matriarch of the frostsabers, residing in Winterspring. With Cataclysm, Shy-Rotam became a permanent quest mob instead of a summoned spawn, enabling hunters of a high enough level to tame her at any time.

Sian-Rotam (pronounced "shan-RO-tom") is a rare frostsaber found in Winterspring. Previously, Sian-Rotam used to come to the aid of his mate Shy-Rotam during the quest Shy-Rotam (Classic). He can now be found as a rare spawn lounging beneath Frostsaber Rock near her. When tamed, Sian-Rotam is identical in appearance to Echeyakee.
